lead: A `Core` member declared `CoreTy::Union(NUMBER)` answers `int|float|decimal`, which no binary operator meets a plain `int` or `float` across.
body: `Core\Math::abs($n) == $m` type-checks and dies at run time with *"nvs-codegen does not lower a binary operator over mismatched representations"*. Write `Core\Math::abs($x) as int` / `as float`; `grep -n 'CoreTy::Union' <the module>` lists the members that owe it.
